column1: # Photosynthetic electron transport chain — citation curation, 2026-09-07
# Applied with:
#   cd Scripts/PlantSEED_v3/Curation
#   python3 Update_Enzymes_in_PlantSEED.py \
#       Curators/samseaver/photosynthesis_citations_260907/update_citations.tsv
# Every DOI below was verified against Crossref (authoritative title/author/year)
# and PubMed (PMID + MeSH organism). See
# Scripts/PlantSEED_v3/Curation/Reviews/2026-09-07_regeneration_notes.md
# for the method and the per-subsystem reports.
# ---- 1. Book chapter removed: PsbK already cites Murata 1988 (the psbK gene
# ----    identification) and Sugimoto 2003, so the proceedings chapter adds
# ----    nothing. Weakest source class per the review guide.
Photosystem II protein PsbK
# ---- 2. Mis-assigned citation moved PsbTn -> PsbI. Ikeuchi & Inoue 1988,
# ----    Plant Cell Physiol 29:1233 characterises the 4.8 kDa polypeptide
# ----    intrinsic to the PSII reaction centre; their companion FEBS Lett paper
# ----    assigns that protein to psbI ("forms an operon with psbK"). PsbTn is a
# ----    separate nuclear-encoded lumenal protein.
Photosystem II protein PsbTn
Photosystem II protein PsbI
# ---- 3. Added: the paper that defines psbI in its modern sense — "we propose to
# ----    revise the definition of psb I as the gene encoding the 4.8 kDa reaction
# ----    centre component". Strongest primary citation available for the role.
Photosystem II protein PsbI
# ---- 4. Off-topic citation removed: a benzopyran-chemistry paper on Piper
# ----    gaudichaudianum, unrelated to photosynthesis. PsaB retains 6 citations
# ----    including Stroher 2008 (Arabidopsis).
Photosystem I subunit Ib PsaB
# ---- 5. Dead DOI removed: 404s at both doi.org and Crossref, and the whole
# ----    CSIRO SA04* series is unregistered, so it is not a typo. PsaN retains
# ----    Haldrup 1999 (Arabidopsis PSI-N) and He 1992.
Photosystem I PsaN
# ---- 6. Consistency: all PSI/PSII assembly and repair factors are include:false
# ----    (their reactions are retained, but no gene is scored into the mature
# ----    complex GPR). Ycf37 and Psb27 were the only two flagged true.
photosystem I assembly related protein Ycf37
Photosystem II protein Psb27
# ---- 7. Empty strings removed from the publications arrays. These are not
# ----    citations; they inflated the apparent citation count for both roles
# ----    (each actually has none). Note the trailing TAB with an empty 4th
# ----    column — that is how REMOVE targets the empty entry.
Photosystem I assembly related protein Ycf3
Photosystem I assembly related protein Ycf4
